column3: Brian, isn't it?
What's it to you, Outsider?
Outsider?
Did you gain entry to our sanctum honourably, with the five-fingered handshake of formality?
I think I was unconscious when the doctor dragged me in here.
Well, that makes you an outsider!
Hello, Brian
Yes, Outsider?
Jared, is it?
Brother Jared, Custodian of the Silken Palms.
I'm entitled to a little respect around here, thank you very much.
AAAAAAAAAAAAUUGGHH!
Fiammetta, what have you done!
*gurgle*
C-Crawling, scratching, n-n-nibbling!
It c-came right for me!
I can't stand their b-beady little eyes!
Don't let it n-near me!
Those t-teeth!
Ahh! I c-can't get it out of my mind!
T-Their worm-like tail. It was h-horrible!
Ah, our latest recruit. Putting yourself to good use?
What do you think of the place? Pretty cool, huh?
The name's Gretchen. I'm in charge of all the itinerary!
What are all these idols for, anyway?
Each one of these idols has a purpose, we use them to keep things orderly.
We have strict protocols, and we follow the rules here, something an outsider like you wouldn't know about, of course.
What's all this talk of a handshake?
You don't know about the handshake?
What is the point of me guarding that curtain all day, if they're going to let people in who don't even know about the handshake?
If you taught me the handshake, would I still be an outsider?
Well, the handshake gets changed every few hours. Besides, you're here now.
Are you sure you don't want to teach me the handshake?
They'll just change it in a few hours, I'd rather not waste my time.
I heard you're the Keeper Of Idols? I need a specific one.
Look, there are a lot of idols back here.
If you can narrow it down, I might be able to find what you're looking for.
Any luck finding that idol? I'm still looking for it.
Like I said, we've got a lot of idols back here.
I'm surprised you haven't sided with Mr Liu.
Really? I don't think it's all that surprising.
I don't agree with his methodology, simple as that.
Besides, he left The Order! He doesn't get to dictate the rules to us now.
Mr Liu seemed fairly upset back there.
Ah, I wouldn't read too much into it.
You're not concerned?
He's probably just gone off to sulk somewhere.
I have to go.
I'll be keeping an eye on you, Outsider.
That's all the help I need right now.
What does a Custodian of the Silken Palms do?
It's my job, nay, my sacred duty to ensure that all members' hands are thoroughly moisturised.
I wish I could unhear that information.
As you can tell, it's not a duty I take lightly. Nothing but moist palms, all round!
Please, stop saying moist.
How'd you get roped into joining this secret society?
I was in it originally to help keep the company on track, you know?
But over time, we got a bit hung up on the ‘helping hands' theme.
You're saying it all got rather heavy-handed.
Exactly! Next thing I know, we're talking secret handshakes, the best hand creams, cuticle care... the works!
I'm way too far down this rabbit hole to climb out now.
I have some questions about the hand idol.
Of course, I'll try to help as best I can.
Do you remember what the idol was made of?
Oh, you mean the Lady Unterwald idol?
Well, it was definitely silver. Or was it solid gold?
Oh dear, it's been too long, I'm afraid!
Can you recall what gesture the idol was making?
Well, it was certainly a hand gesture...
Can you recall any specifics?
Sorry, pal. If you moisturise enough hands, they all kind of blur together!
Was there a quote on the idol?
A quote? Yes, there was definitely something sentimental about it.
Sorry I couldn't be more helpful.
What's Mr Liu so impatient about?
Oh, don't mind him. He just expects everything to go his way all the time!
Jian is a man of action, but we have processes in place for a reason!
I thought Jian raised some rather urgent points.
I agree, but we can't go barrelling in there and meddling with Lady Unterwald's affairs.
It's much better to take a deliberate, more thought out approach.
It seems the voting has stalled. Any ideas?
We'll need a coherent answer out of Mr Masson in order to break the deadlock.
Perhaps you can persuade him in some way?
Talk to you later, I have to go...
Any tips on catching that mouse?
It won't be easy, attorney. That little devil has shortcuts everywhere.
We tried to plug them all up, but there's too many!
Good news, I've apprehended that mouse!
What should I do with this mouse?
Give it here, attorney.
No one lays a whisker on Fiametta without facing consequences!
Hmm I think I'll hang onto her for now.
It's your funeral, attorney.
Any chance of a tour of the kitchen?
A tour? I'm afraid a tour of the kitchen will have to wait.
The timing right now? It's not ideal.
Oh, that's okay.
Ahh, you twist my arm, attorney. Of course, I'll give you a tour!
Come closer, and I will show you the star of the show. Fiametta!
You should tell me all about Fiametta!
You really want to know?
No, I'm not sure that you can handle it.
I can handle it, give me the full spiel on Fiametta!
Okay, well, you asked for it.
Allow me to introduce you to Fiametta, referred to by her manufacturers as the Easy Chef 500. She comes forged in cast iron steel...
Fiametta has not one, but two baking ovens! A broiler drawer that's ideal for browning the tops of casseroles, caramelising your meats, or even roasting your vegetables. But that's not all!
It's not?!

We're not talking your standard dual cook-top burners, we're not even talking four. Fiametta has six cook-top burners, an upper warming compartment that keeps optimum temperatures for your soups and sauces, and if that wasn't enough, a lower storage drawer for your additional kitchenware.
Wow!
I assume you've heard about Lady Unterwald?
Ah, attorney, c'est une tragédie !
It's terrible! We even had to throw away perfectly good ingredients to fit her in the pantry.
Excuse me?
You heard me. Don't go snooping around in the freezer, or you'll give yourself a scare.
Are you saying Lady Unterwald is stored in your freezer?
Lady Unterwald needs to be on ice until the authorities can reach us.
There was no other alternative, attorney!
I don't think Lady Unterwald would have approved of your storage methods.
Would you prefer Lady Unterwald to lay where she fell, in front of her paying passengers?
When you consider the alternative, this is a more dignified resting place, no?
I suppose so.
I should get back to finding that mouse.
Good luck, attorney.
I need to go now.
Did you say you had an inspection earlier?
The health department sent a puny little drone to inspect our premises.
If there's anything I detest more than rodents, it's health inspectors.
Strutting about as if they rule the roost, they are the real pests!
You mentioned the mouse only steals valuables?
Indeed, we're down to our last cheese knife.
It's also found a way into our pantry, there must be tunnels everywhere.
Where do you think that mouse came from, anyway?
It's not uncommon for rodents to sneak aboard a departing train.
But that mouse? That little devil came from the gates of hell!
Tell me more about your rodent problem.
That creature is no ordinary rodent, it's pure evil.
It's out there... watching us, plotting its next attack.
Calm down, Remy. Our attorney is on the case!
Any advice on nabbing that mouse?
I'd try to trap it in an enclosed space.
It won't be so simple, though. That little thief is a professional.
Mind if I have a poke around your kitchen?
Poke around?
You may have free rein of the kitchen, but there is to be no poking!
Good luck, attorney. We're counting on you.
I'll leave you to it.
Merci, attorney.
What's making you so jittery?
That creature is out there... watching us, plotting its next attack.
Ugh, the mere thought of it makes my skin crawl!
I'll bet that mouse is just as scared of you, as you are of it!
Please don't say that word! You're making me itch!
Are you feeling a bit more at ease now?
Knowing that vile beast is safely contained is a big weight off my mind.
I cannot thank you enough, attorney.
Any advice for capturing that mouse?
D-don't try to touch it with your bare hands, they c-can be extremely vicious.
Beware of the bite, got it.
Ugh, you just reminded me of those horrible gnawing teeth.
I'm feeling nauseous just thinking about it!
I don't care what you do, as long as you keep it far away from me!
Tell me, what's your role in the kitchen?
As the Entremétier, it's my job to prepare the entrées.
Between you and me, I think I was only hired to help François with his palate problem.
There's a problem with the head chef's palate?
Oui, I'm afraid his taste is as dull as dishwater!
Don't speak a word of this to anyone, I'm afraid he's quite sensitive about it.
You taste all the food before it leaves the kitchen?
I'm supposed to, but how can I taste anything with that rodent running around?
I can't be expected to work under these conditions!
They've got you shucking oysters, huh?
I don't mind it!
Have you tried oysters before? They're a delicacy, no?
Turns out my stomach has a delicacy, so I think I'll give them a miss going forward.
I'd better get back to it.
Please hurry, I can't take much more of this.
I'll leave you to your work.
Merci!
What can you tell me about the Keeper of Many Idols?
Brother Brian? He has a good eye for detail.
We put him on security most nights, he seems to enjoy it.
We like to keep him busy, you see.
How'd you end up as the leader of a secret society?
Same as all the other secret societies. We took a vote!
Fire away!
Hmm, let me think.
Some sort of metal, was it? No, that's not right.
You know, the same guy who made the idol also sculpted the Unterwald busts.
You mean the statues I've seen around the train?
I wouldn't be surprised if they used the same material!
Ah, I remember it being a majestic pose.
I always thought it captured Lady Unterwald perfectly.
I don't suppose you remember the quote on the idol?
Hmm, I think it was something sappy. Was it something about family?
Very well, anything else?
Aren't you worried about Mr Liu?
He did seem pretty irate, I hope he doesn't do anything rash.
I should be leaving now.
Farewell!
You need an itinerary? What does that entail?
Oh my goodness, what doesn't it entail?

There's the two-hour all-hands meeting on the candles, somebody's got to maintain the weekly rota for the plumping up of the sofa cushions, and I didn't even mention the five-fingered handshake of formality.
We change that twice daily, you know!
So, wait a second. You just spend all your time in meetings?
You really think we should just light up a bunch of candles without having a long meeting about it beforehand?
Has everyone rolled up their sleeves? What's the consistency of the wax? Are we absolutely sure there's nothing flammable nearby?
How'd you end up in the Order of Idle Hands?
Honestly, when I got here, there was no structure at all. I mostly joined out of pity.
I've got a production background, so if there's a chart or a spreadsheet involved, sign me up!
I also double as the fire marshal, can't be too careful around all these open flames!
Indeed!
Mr Liu seems quite irate at The Order. What happened?
Oh, he's probably just stewing over the sandwiches we'd bring in for lunch.
You know, those mini sandwiches with the crusts cut off?
He couldn't stand them!
Mr Liu disagreed with you over sandwiches?
It's not like I made them personally, but you should have heard him!
“It ruins the structural integrity of the sandwich, Gretchen!”
“That's where all the flavour and texture is, Gretchen!”
It was all downhill from there, really.
I have some questions about the missing hand idol.
Hmm, the idol...
The Unterwald idol was pretty fancy, but I couldn't tell you what it was made of.
I don't remember it being an offensive gesture. Does that help?
I suppose it narrows it down.
There was! It was something involving the Unterwalds.
Why aren't you voting for direct action?
We can't go rushing around, meddling in Lady Unterwald's affairs!
There are long-established, extremely slow processes we must abide by.
Is the vote still deadlocked?
Rules are rules, we can't do anything until everyone here has cast their vote.
But we can call another vote at any time?
Of course, anyone present can request another vote.
You'll just need to ask the leader.
I should go.
Hold on, gentlemen, I think he's coming round.
Wh-what happened?
His Hand!
Poor thing!
Not to worry, though! I brought you to the experts. We managed to get you all patched up.
Here, take this hand cream. It's the good stuff. Loosens any cramps right up.
It also moisturises!
Where am I?
No need to fret, Herman. You're in safe hands here.
Although the members need their table back, there's a meeting starting soon.
Everyone, our meeting can now commence!
At last! I have much to discuss with you.
Hold on, where's the hand idol?
You know, the hand idol we use to signify that it's our turn to speak!
SILENCE!
Sorry! I'm getting ahead of myself.
Brother Jared speaks the truth. We cannot proceed without the hand idol.
It's bound to turn up somewhere, it couldn't have gone far!
I really must insist we press on. This issue with Lady Unterwald, it cannot wait!
We must be patient, Jian. The hand works in mysterious ways.
That's right.
So, you're all going to sit here and do nothing?
You know, I'm quite good at finding things. I may be able to assist?
Yes, that would be most appreciated!
Oh! We could ask the Keeper of Many Idols!
That's a grand idea!
Are you there, Keeper Of Many Idols?
KEEPER OF MANY IDOLS? Are you there?
BRIAN!
Yes?
I shall enquire with Brian, the Keeper Of Many Idols.
This is the work of that meddling murine, no question.
Non mais, et puis quoi encore !
Quoi ! What is it you want? As you can see, we're very busy here.
We're in the middle of dinner prep. What is it?
Back again? C'est une honte !
Pour qui tu te prends ! What is it you want?
Pardon?
He says you're pushing your luck! What is it you want?
It smells like onion soup.
That's a well stocked spice rack!
